jobs.title: Early Careers: Junior C#/SQL Developer & Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Early Careers: Junior C#/ SQL Developer & Data Analytics**

Are you curious about the Insurance industry? Interested in working with a team of experts who are generous with sharing their knowledge, and joining an industry leading, highly inclusive organization? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Montreal office.

**Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.**

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

* Maintaining and enhancing our in‑house applications built primarily with C#, .NET and Microsoft SQL Server, including adding new features, improving usability, and solving bugs raised by users.
* Fulfilling ad‑hoc data requests from colleagues by writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, validate and format information from our systems for business, operational and reporting needs.
* Building and supporting automation solutions (mail merge, Excel macros, C# utilities and SQL Server scripts) that streamline office workflows and improve efficiency.
* Acting as a liaison between business users and Aon IT, helping to translate user requirements into technical requests (e.g., application changes, folder or network access, permission updates).
* Partnering with Aon IT teams to coordinate and test system upgrades, patches and infrastructure changes, ensuring our C#/.NET and SQL Server–based applications remain stable and available with minimal downtime.
* Developing and maintaining business reports (for example, attendance and other key performance or operational reports) using tools such as Crystal Reports, Excel and SQL Server.
* Documenting changes, processes and user guides to support knowledge transfer and provide clear references for both technical teams and non‑technical users.
* Participating in regular team meetings to discuss priorities, review upcoming work, and contribute ideas for improving our systems and processes

**How this opportunity is different**

This role provides an opportunity to observe the full lifecycle of internal tools and applications, from understanding end‑user needs through composing, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will have direct contact with business users, giving you a clear view of how your work improves efficiency and supports critical day‑to‑day operations. You will be working for a business unit supporting high profile clients in the professional services industries, operating in multiple insurance markets (US, UK, Bermuda, Canada) and will have the chance to interact with people from all those locations.

We are a small team, you will gain broad, hands‑on experience across application development, data/reporting, automation and basic infrastructure coordination rather than being limited to a narrow specialization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues in both the business and Aon IT, with opportunities for mentorship, on‑the‑job learning and exposure to enterprise‑grade tools and environments.

The systems you support are important to our business; you will quickly see the impact of your work and be encouraged to propose and implement improvements.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

  

* Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Software engineering, Computer science, Programming specialization, Information technology specialization, Systems Administration, or a relevant field;
* Hands‑on experience with C# (preferably using WPF) in Visual Studio, including building and debugging desktop applications (academic, internship, or professional);
* Understanding of object‑oriented programming and development protocols;
* Solid understanding of SQL, with a strong preference for Microsoft SQL Server (writing queries, joins, basic performance tuning, and simple stored procedures);
* Experience with Microsoft Access for database queries, table design, and relationships
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for basic web pages and user interfaces
* Strong Excel skills (formulas, functions, sorting/filtering)
* Experience integrating C# applications with Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Outlook, Word) programmatically is an asset
* Basic understanding of SharePoint
* Experience with Kentico or Sitecore is an asset
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written;
* French / English bilingualism required due to frequent interactions with clients, colleagues, or partners based in Quebec, other Canadian provinces and/or internationally.
* High discernment and professional presentation skills.

***Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.***

jobs.title: Software Developer Coop
jobs.description:
**Role description**

As an **intern within the Developer Platform team** , you may contribute to different types of initiatives related to agentic AI, automation, development platforms, and the improvement of software engineering practices, depending on current priorities and the squad you are assigned to. The specific mandate will be confirmed later, but may include:

* Contribute to the exploration, prototyping, or integration of agentic AI solutions that support developers in their day-to-day activities, such as understanding code, automating tasks, analyzing pipelines, or helping resolve issues.
* Participate in improving the developer experience by simplifying the practices, tools, and processes used daily by software teams.
* Contribute to intelligent engineering initiatives, including collecting, analyzing, or visualizing data to better understand engineering performance and identify opportunities for AI-assisted support.
* Help automate recurring operational processes to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and accelerate platform adoption at scale.
* Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, or secure delivery mechanisms that may integrate AI-assisted analysis, recommendation, or automation capabilities.
* Participate in work related to development, integration, deployment, or operations platforms, including cloud, containerized, or automated environments.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product owners to understand team needs and propose practical improvements.
* Explore and prototype solutions that improve the productivity, quality, security, visibility, or actionability of software development teams.

**Candidate profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Passionate** about technology and automation.
* **Curious** , with an interest in learning and experimenting.
* **Proactive** , able to take initiative.
* **Strong in problem-solving** , with a logical and creative approach.

**Desired technical skills:**

* Currently enrolled in a university or college program in software engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* Previous hands-on exposure to software development concepts and at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, PowerShell, or Bash, through coursework, labs, personal projects, or internships.
* Basic practical experience with CI/CD, DevOps, software development platforms, or collaborative development tools such as Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or Jira.
* Some exposure to automation, scripting, integrations, APIs, or operational improvements that reduce manual work and improve developer productivity.
* Exposure to cloud, container, or infrastructure concepts through coursework, labs, personal projects, or previous internships.
* Familiarity, even at an introductory level, with technologies such as Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Copilot, Azure, Artifactory, ArgoCD, or similar platform engineering tools.
* Basic awareness or prior exposure to AI-assisted software development, software quality, cybersecurity, and modern platform engineering practices.

**About CAE**
=============

*At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.*

**Position Type**
=================

COOP-Student (Fixed Term)

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**
======================================

*CAE is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, veteran status, age, or other characteristics protected by law. We encourage applicants who may not meet every qualification to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available—contact your recruiter or email* *CAECarrieres-Careers@cae.com* *if needed.*

**Data Privacy**
================

Privacy Statement | CAE

*As part of our process, we may use AI‑supported tools to help review applications, with human decision‑making at every step. CAE thanks all applicants for their interest. However, only those whose background and experience match the requirements of the role will be contacted.*

jobs.description:

Zernam Enterprise Inc. is hiring a skilled Power Platform & GenAI Developer for one of our clients. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, Large Language Models (LLMs), and database integrations to build intelligent business applications, automate workflows, and integrate enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop business applications using Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven Apps.
* Build and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate.
* Develop interactive dashboards and business solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI GPT, Claude, and other LLMs.
* Create AI assistants, chatbots, and AI-powered workflow automation solutions.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize LLM outputs for business use cases.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, Web Services, and Connectors.
* Create and optimize database Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, and SQL Queries.
* Design data models and integrate solutions with SQL Server, Dataverse, SharePoint, and cloud data sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable solutions.
* Ensure security, governance, performance optimization, and best practices across Power Platform and AI implementations.

**Required Skills**

**Microsoft Power Platform**

* Power Apps: Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Power Automate: Flows and Workflow Automation.
* Dataverse.
* Power Platform Administration and Governance.
* Dashboard and Reporting Development.

**Generative AI / AI Development**

* Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* OpenAI GPT Models.
* Anthropic Claude.
* Prompt Engineering.
* LLM Integration and Fine-Tuning Concepts.
* AI Agent Development.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* AI-powered Workflow Automation.

**Database & Integration**

* SQL Server.
* Stored Procedures (SPs).
* Views.
* Database Design and Data Modeling.
* REST APIs.
* JSON/XML.
* API Integration and Development.

**Nice to Have**

* Azure OpenAI Services.
* Azure Functions.
* Logic Apps.
* SharePoint Online.
* Microsoft Fabric.
* Python for AI integrations.
* Azure AI Foundry

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Jr. Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Invitation Project is committed to developing creative approaches to motivate, train, encourage, and support users in sharing the Christian gospel.**THE PROJECT**

We are building a subscription-based Evangelism platform to enable ordinary Christians to share their faith.

**THE POSITION**

We are seeking a motivated **Junior Full-Stack Developer** to join our team and help build the core infrastructure of our hybrid evangelism app. You will work closely with senior engineers to design, develop, and maintain the platform's **front and back end**, focusing on writing clean TypeScript/Node.js code and learning best practices for scalability.

This role is perfect for a candidate who is passionate about technology, eager to learn **hybrid mobile development (React Native / Flutter)**, and curious about **relational databases (PostgreSQL)**. You will collaborate in a supportive environment to help deliver an engaging user experience worldwide.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Collaborate** with senior developers to build and scale a hybrid mobile application.
* **Help manage** relational **SQL databases** and learn data modelling techniques.
* **Support the development** of backend REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
* **Help implement** new frontend features and UI components for mobile and web.
* **Ensure smooth authentication** using Firebase Auth / Auth0 / Supabase.
* **Integrate payment processing** with Stripe, PayPal, or Paddle for subscriptions.
* **Implement cloud storage solutions** (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Cloudflare R2).
* **Develop and maintain** push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) / OneSignal.
* **Optimize the application's performance and security**.
* **Collaborate** with designers, content managers, and other stakeholders.
* **Write clean, maintainable code** and follow software development best practices.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Must be a dedicated Christian and willing to sign a statement of faith
* Willingness to sign a non-disclosure, non-compete agreement.
* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar experience**.
* **Basic experience** with or a strong desire to learn full-stack development.
* **Familiarity** with modern frontend frameworks such as React, React Native, or Flutter, alongside HTML5/CSS3 and TypeScript.
* **Foundational knowledge** of backend programming and API concepts.
* **Experience working with relational databases** (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and ORMs such as Prisma or TypeORM.
* **Familiarity with cloud platforms** (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
* **Knowledge of authentication & security protocols** (OAuth, JWT, Firebase Auth, or Auth0).
* **Experience with payment gateway integration** (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, etc.).
* **Understanding of Git version control and CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions, Docker) for efficient deployment.
* Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and receive constructive feedback.
* Ability to work **independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously**.
* Passion for evangelism and using technology to spread the Gospel.

**BENEFITS**

* Flexible working hours and **remote work options**.
* Opportunity to be part of a **mission-driven organization**.
* A collaborative and **supportive team environment**.
* The chance to **work on cutting-edge technology** for evangelism.

If you don't meet all these requirements but are excited by the opportunity, please feel free to apply anyway.

Pay: $60,000.00-$80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Flexible schedule
* On-site parking
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Burnaby, BC

jobs.title: Jr. Software Engineer, AI Agent Platform
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, is a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

  
  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time AI pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build real-time voice AI features for emergency response workflows.
* Design and operate LLM-powered systems that support human 911 telecommunicators.
* Own features across the stack, from backend services and AI pipelines to frontend interfaces and internal tools.
* Work on low-latency audio processing, streaming systems, telephony integrations, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
* Help integrate speech models, LLMs, and emerging AI technologies into production systems.

* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Help write and improve evaluation, testing, and observability for AI-assisted systems.
* Participate in on-call responsibilities (with support and shadow rotations to start), backed by clear runbooks and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

**You Might Be a Fit If**
-------------------------

* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
* You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

**Relevant Experience**
-----------------------

We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.

Relevant exposure may include:

* Projects involving LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.
* Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
* Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
* Programming in Elixir, Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL or relational data modeling.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Docker, Kubernetes, or similar deployment environments.
* Internships or co-ops in software engineering, infrastructure, or AI/ML roles.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest

  
  

#LI-RS1

#LI-Remote

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

Bachelor's degree

Experience with LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

New Grad

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes  

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Information**
  
Job Requisition ID: 88284
  
Ministry: Technology and Innovation
  
Location: Edmonton
  
Full or Part-Time: Full-Time
  
Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week
  
Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent
  
Scope: Open Competition
  
Closing Date: October 13, 2026
  
Classification: Systems Analyst 1
  
Salary: $2,533.72 to $3,799.96 bi-weekly ($66,130 - $99,178/year)

  

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

  

Technology and Innovation is responsible for making innovation and technology the driving force behind Alberta’s economic growth and diversification.

  

The Digital Design and Delivery (DDD) division is the Government of Alberta’s centre of digital delivery. It partners with ministries to design simpler, faster, and better services; build capability and confidence in modern digital practices; and assure service quality and value through standards and controls. Multidisciplinary product teams are assigned priority GoA projects and employ an agile, product-oriented approach in providing solutions for ministry partners.

  

Within DDD, the Software Delivery Branch provides architectural leadership, CloudOps, DevOps practices, quality engineering, and software delivery excellence across product and platform teams. The Digital Architect plays a key role in shaping how digital solutions are designed, evolved, and governed, balancing innovation with reliability, security, and public sector responsibility.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------

The Software Delivery branch is looking for six (6) Junior Full Stack Developers (FSD). Reporting to the Director, Software Development, this role supports the team in the design and implementation of software with a focus on iterative, continuous development, where requirements and solutions evolve through collaboration between cross-functional teams and users.

  

This role explicitly requires AI capability, creating systems with AI as a co-developer. So, we are seeking developers who can build, integrate, and optimize AI-driven solutions in addition to traditional front-end and back-end development.

  

The responsibilities of this role include:

* Develop and maintain front-end and back-end solutions, including AI-enabled features and digital services.
* Collaborate with agile teams, stakeholders, and users to design, build, and improve digital products.
* Contribute to backlog planning, effort estimation, and the delivery of high-quality software features.
* Apply development best practices, including testing, code reviews, CI/CD automation, and source control.
* Research emerging technologies and AI tools to identify opportunities for innovation and service improvement.
* Provide technical support and recommendations while communicating solutions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  

To be successful in this position, you will demonstrate:

* Ability to self-learn a variety of software tools.
* Ability to keep up with industry standards and new tools or resources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position

**APS Competencies**
--------------------

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

  

* **Builds Collaborative Environment**: Engages diverse stakeholders and fosters collaboration through shared resources and inclusive dialogue. Resolves conflict through facilitation and coaching while valuing different perspectives to achieve outcomes.
* **Creative Problem Solving:** Uses diverse approaches to analyze problems and generate solutions. Encourages collaboration and brings the right people together to resolve issues.
* **Agility:** Adapts quickly to changing priorities and incorporates improvements into work. Stays composed under pressure and helps others adjust to change.
* **Develop Self and Others:** Builds individual and team capability through learning and development. Promotes shared learning and supports personal development planning.
* **Systems Thinking:** Considers broader trends, risks, and context when making decisions. Aligns actions with organizational goals and addresses barriers to progress.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Requirements:**

* A related two-year diploma in computer technology or a related discipline from a recognized post-secondary institution.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including secure, scalable application development, testing, CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, source control, code reviews, and the full software development lifecycle.).
* A cover letter clearly demonstrating relevant skills and competencies tailored to this position.
  

**Equivalencies:**

* A related one-year certificate from a recognized post-secondary institution and one (1) year of related experience.
  

**Assets:**

* Experience designing, developing, and supporting modern full-stack applications using front-end technologies, back-end services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, and scalable enterprise architectures.
* Experience developing, integrating, and supporting AI-powered applications using modern frameworks, APIs, cloud services, automation platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of AI software engineering practices, including responsible AI principles, governance requirements, secure development, deployment, monitoring, API integration, and enterprise technology standards.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation technologies to solve business problems, improve efficiency and user experience, and collaborate effectively wi

**Power Platform & GenAI Developer**

Zernam Enterprise Inc. is hiring a skilled Power Platform & GenAI Developer for one of our clients. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, Large Language Models (LLMs), and database integrations to build intelligent business applications, automate workflows, and integrate enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop business applications using Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven Apps.
* Build and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate.
* Develop interactive dashboards and business solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI GPT, Claude, and other LLMs.
* Create AI assistants, chatbots, and AI-powered workflow automation solutions.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize LLM outputs for business use cases.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, Web Services, and Connectors.
* Create and optimize database Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, and SQL Queries.
* Design data models and integrate solutions with SQL Server, Dataverse, SharePoint, and cloud data sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable solutions.
* Ensure security, governance, performance optimization, and best practices across Power Platform and AI implementations.

**Required Skills**

**Microsoft Power Platform**

* Power Apps: Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Power Automate: Flows and Workflow Automation.
* Dataverse.
* Power Platform Administration and Governance.
* Dashboard and Reporting Development.

**Generative AI / AI Development**

* Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* OpenAI GPT Models.
* Anthropic Claude.
* Prompt Engineering.
* LLM Integration and Fine-Tuning Concepts.
* AI Agent Development.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* AI-powered Workflow Automation.

**Database & Integration**

* SQL Server.
* Stored Procedures (SPs).
* Views.
* Database Design and Data Modeling.
* REST APIs.
* JSON/XML.
* API Integration and Development.

**Nice to Have**

* Azure OpenAI Services.
* Azure Functions.
* Logic Apps.
* SharePoint Online.
* Microsoft Fabric.
* Python for AI integrations.
* Azure AI Foundry

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
